title: FAQ
description:
The disclosure list for `patterns/faq-section.php` — one `core/accordion` holding one `core/accordion-item` per question. LS-4215.

Reuses `styles/blocks/accordion/call-us-dropdown.json`'s token vocabulary (neutral-300/600/800, base, border-radius-200, shadow-300, spacing-10, the shared font-weight/letter-spacing/line-height customs) rather than inventing new visual decisions, per FR-007 — this is deliberate consistency, not copy-paste laziness.

⚠️ **Does NOT carry `call-us-dropdown.json`'s `.wp-block-accordion-panel[hidden]{display:none !important;}` override, and must not.** That override trades away `beforematch` — a closed panel can no longer be opened by in-page Find or a `#hash` link — which is the right trade for four phone numbers in a header and the wrong one here: a visitor following `#faq-{slug}` from elsewhere on the site, or using Ctrl+F to find an answer, must be able to land on a closed question and have it open. Left at core's default `hidden="until-found"` behaviour (`content-visibility:hidden`, not `display:none`), which supports exactly that. See research.md R-02 in specs/002-faq-system.

Also omits `call-us-dropdown.json`'s pop-out positioning rules (`position:absolute`, `inset-*`, `z-index`) — those exist there because that accordion opens a floating panel over a header bar. An FAQ panel is a normal in-flow disclosure; it should push following content down when open, which is the default `core/accordion-panel` behaviour with nothing overridden.
